title: Cascade Ingest — Roadmap-Grade Extraction (v1)
description: The canonical shape an extraction agent must return after reading an ingested external source (video transcript, article, podcast, etc.). Tuned for mining external thought-leadership/competitor content into Cascade roadmap candidates — NOT shallow firehose triage (see cascade_ingest_curator_item) and NOT org-decision routing (see /cse:mine). cascade_implications is the load-bearing field: each entry must be specific enough to become an execution package. Extended additively for /cse:model-radar with OPTIONAL stance-tagged evidence fields (stance, model_refs, benchmark_refs) — optional for all other ingest flows.

source.description: Provenance of the ingested source, captured by the Phase-1 adapter (NOT the extraction itself — kept here so the shape is uniform across adapters). The skill copies this into the package's type_data.source. Source-agnostic: a YouTube adapter fills kind/url/video_id/author; a URL adapter fills url(normalized)/title/author/site/published_date; a paste adapter fills whatever the user supplies (url optional). url should be the NORMALIZED url (lowercased host; utm_*/fbclid/gclid + fragment + trailing slash stripped) so it is dedup-comparable.

url.description: Normalized canonical URL of the source (optional for paste).

site.description: Publication / site name (e.g. 'The Verge'), for non-YouTube sources.

published_date.description: ISO date the source was published, if discoverable.

summary.description: 4-6 sentence neutral summary of the source's core argument.

key_points.description: 8-15 substantive claims/insights. Each a full standalone sentence carrying the specific detail/number/example from the source (not generic).

competitive_signals.description: What the source implies about the market, competitors, moats, or dangers — for competitive analysis.

cascade_implications.description: THE load-bearing field. Specable feature/workflow ideas Cascade could build or improve, each mapped to an existing primitive and sized.

maps_to_existing.description: Which Cascade concept it extends (CSE pipeline, package primitive, verification gates, etc.) or 'new'.

contradictions_or_risks.description: Anything in the source that challenges Cascade's current direction or that we should pressure-test.

stance.description: OPTIONAL — the epistemic stance of the source w.r.t. model-quality claims: lab_claim = the model's own lab asserting quality; independent_eval = third-party structured evaluation; practitioner_take = hands-on practitioner opinion/experience. Used by /cse:model-radar; optional for all other ingest flows.

model_refs.description: OPTIONAL — canonical model release slugs mentioned substantively in the source (lowercase-hyphenated, e.g. 'claude-fable-5', 'gpt-5', 'gemini-2.5-pro'). Used by /cse:model-radar.

benchmark_refs.description: OPTIONAL — benchmark/eval slugs the source cites (lowercase-hyphenated, e.g. 'swe-bench', 'mmlu', 'arc-agi'). Used by /cse:model-radar.
